name: merge gate: a flaky job re-run to green merges without anyone re-arming it
description: Both keys are in while an end-to-end job has failed: the gate stops (no polling) and says CI is failing. A person re-runs the flaky job; when its check suite completes green on the same head, the gateway wakes the gate and it merges.

model_output.summary: Adds a retry to the export job.
